arms.R1: frozen IF-01 A2, including each peeling stage
arms.D: support distribution diagnostics; outputs reference R1
arms.S: same A2 with one pre-competition internal decomposition pass

input: Same 15 source videos, original 5fps/800 samples, frozen IF-01 A2 references and verified local correspondences. Regions 4x4, 0.8s bins, 1px dedup, 4 recurring sites, 3 matched sites, floor 8. Exact same area IDs and scores. Fine point support is diagnostic only.
clustering: Deterministic greedy complete-link region clustering, edges require >=2 common positive bins and positive-bin Jaccard >=0.6. Add to the compatible cluster with greatest weakest Jaccard, then stable first-created cluster. Reference view is retained, same cell across views never equated. Consider clusters with same-view >=2 regions and >=2 positive bins. Require exactly two eligible clusters. An unassigned region compatible with all members of both clusters may be shared without coalescing identities, under original per-view budget.
proposal_gate: Each child independently satisfies original A2 measure. Need >=2 positive exclusive samples in >=2 bins per child, ignoring self and witnesses with a full-frame near-duplicate (HSV<=0.04 and gray MAD<=0.02, frozen cutoffs) in the opposing positive set. Missing evidence remains unknown; exclusive is observed coverage within this sample, not semantic disproof. Same two fixed candidate sets must have observed-bin Jaccard<=0.5. Keep dual support in score/competition logs; use original 0.12 margin and original two rounds including refusal to decide on unresolved competition.
order_and_revert: One pass through each original parent. Proposals ordered by decreasing minimum exclusive witness bin count, then parent ID. Max 6 active IDs, 2 views per ID, 8 regions per view; rejected or capacity-blocked parents retained. Original parent records always restorable; use original parent ID for first child and next unused numeric ID for second with explicit mapping. No post-hoc rollback based on truth, no replacements, reactivation, ordinary-member promotion or threshold sweep.
downstream: Call original IF-01 refinement and both unchanged peeling rounds. Preserve all source candidates, quality, motion, transition, frozen 8-image selector, V/uniform controls. Resample R1 and S independently at 10fps for room_corridor_dev, dissolve and 16455680, first coarse bracket +/-0.5s or middle third. Source-clipped windows.
evaluation: Before D/S replay A2 candidates and all three scoring snapshots exactly. Then D for all clips before S for all clips. Only after all predictions read frozen labels and generator endpoints. Use common union of original v05 prototypes, IF-01 historical comparison refs and all current arms' refs. Count decisions, abstentions, all pair denominators, same splits and different merges. Evaluate chronological first candidate without selecting best, missing=null. Report all candidates, evidence/selection/abstention changes, no generalization or Agent claims.
